
The code for the manuscript of "Large-scale multi-omics profiling reveals environmental and evolutionary drivers of fungal phylogeographic and metabolic diversity".


# Figure 1. 

# Figure 1a is a phylogenetic tree file generated by Treebest and drawn in the Itol web tool based on the sample attribute data. The genome-wide SNPs were used to construct the phylogenetic tree for 1,064 samples using the Neighbor-Joining method using TreeBeST (v1.9.2) with parameters “-b 1000”.  We shared the tree file analysis results in https://itol.embl.de/export/4514215823780531729730334. Figure 1b was generated using the data visualization tool Hiplot(https://hiplot.cn/basic/beanplot). Figure 1c is drawn in Adobe illustrate software after the Linux cluster calculated the Fst and π values between different subpopulations. 

# Figure 2.

# The map in Figure 2a was drawn using ArcGIS software, and the maximum likelihood phylogenetic tree in the outer circle was generated using IQTREE2 and then drawn using the Itol phylogenetic tree file visualization tool. The phylogenetic tree + heat map in Figure 2b was completed in the Itol tool, and the metabolite molecular family network diagram above was generated by GNPS and then drawn in the Cytoscape software. 

# Figure 3. 

# We provided the script and pan-genome dataset for drawing Figure 3a. Figure 3b was generated by the pan-genome analysis software EUPAN (v0.44). Figure 3c,d,e,f was generated using the data visualization tool Hiplot(https://hiplot.cn/basic/).

# Figure 4. 

# The evolutionary tree in Figure 4a was drawn using the Itol web tool, and the heat map in the upper left corner was drawn using the metabolome analysis tool Metaboanalyst (https://www.metaboanalyst.ca/). Figures 4b and 4c were drawn using the gene-rank-dotplot.R script we provided. Figure 4d-i was drawn on the Dr.Tom cloud platform (BGI, shenzhen). 


# Figure 5.

# Figure 5a was drawn using ggplot2, and Figure 6b was drawn using Adobe illustrator software.
# Figure 6.

# Figure 6a, b was drawn using Plink software and the cmplot R package. It is easy to draw according to the software instructions and the default parameters provided. Figure 5e, f-i were drawn using the metabolome analysis tool Metaboanalyst (https://www.metaboanalyst.ca/). Figure 5j was calculated using XP-CLR software and the Manhattan plot was drawn using the ggplot2 package. Figure 5j was calculated using XP-CLR software and the Manhattan plot was drawn using the cmplot R package. Figure5k was generated using the data visualization tool Hiplot(https://hiplot.cn/basic/circular-barplot). 

# Figure 7.

# All the graphs in Figure 7 are drawn on the Hiplot drawing cloud platform (https://hiplot.cn/basic/).
